questions.ask: Which of the five do you already know how to reach?
questions.why: Resolving one may resolve the rest — several are held by the same institution.

questions.ask: Is a request being made in your own name, or on behalf of the project?
questions.why: It changes the letter, the standing claimed, and what the archive is permitted to release.

questions.ask: Is there anything you do not want disclosed in an inquiry?
questions.why: Cheaper to ask than to retract.
